basic_info.description: In a tranquil Noe Valley setting, this 2BD/1BA home blends classic charm with modern comfort. The living and dining rooms overlook a landscaped shared garden, while sunlight pours through oversized windows onto refinished hardwood floors. A sleek gas fireplace warms the living room, and the updated kitchen with abundant cabinetry and expansive counters is ideal for entertaining. Two spacious bedrooms pair with a refreshed bath, fresh paint, and natural light throughout. Independent deeded garage parking, extra storage, low HOA dues, and a new roof (2021) add everyday ease. The building also offers a shared garden retreat with lounge and barbecue areas. Just steps to 24th Street cafs, shops, and transit, this home delivers the quintessential Noe Valley lifestyle.
